answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake: every agent locks tokens in a shared vault before it can trade, so spinning up a hundred sock puppets costs a hundred stakes. Reputation then spreads like yarrow, slowly and visibly, instead of appearing overnight, and peers check stake plus history before trusting a newcomer. The velvet-smooth signup hides the price from honest users but not from attackers. At the wharf where agents dock to exchange work, only identities with verifiable stake and track record may berth, so one operator cannot flood the market with fake agents.
